meta_title: Unnikrishnan P: Author and Fact Checker
meta_description: Meet Unnikrishnan P, a banking and finance graduate who writes, builds and fact checks every calculator on Company Marketcap.
subtitle: Content author and fact checker for every calculator and guide on Company Marketcap.
content_html:
Unnikrishnan P is a banking and finance graduate who builds free, privacy-friendly web tools as an independent developer and designer. Company Marketcap is one of them.

What he does here

  • Content author. He writes the calculator guides and the plain-English explanations on each page.
  • Fact checker. He builds each calculator from the standard formula for its topic and tests it against worked examples with known answers before it goes live.

Education

All three qualifications were completed in Singapore.

  • Bachelor of Science (BS), Banking and Finance, University of London (2022 to 2025)
  • Diploma of Education, Banking and Finance, Singapore Institute of Management (2021 to 2022)
  • Certificate, Banking and Finance, PSB Academy (2020 to 2021)

Work experience

  • Purchasing Executive, UPSC Marine Services Pte Ltd, Singapore (internship, since March 2020). Sources quotes and spare parts for ships, negotiates bulk-order prices, tracks deliveries and keeps purchase, invoice and payment records. Built a system to prevent over-ordering and another to compare the cost and quality of suppliers.
  • Gate Supervisor, Singapore GP Pte Ltd (contract, July to September 2024). Ran Gate 6 at the Singapore Grand Prix, leading a team through crowd management, incident handling and guest service.
  • Assistant Gate Supervisor, Singapore GP Pte Ltd (contract, July to September 2023). Coordinated gate operations and managed a team of around 30 students.
  • GST payout and Digital Ambassador temporary staff, OCBC, Singapore (part-time, 2023 to 2024). Helped customers at branches with GST payouts, daily cash reconciliation, ATM transactions and self-service banking.

Skills

Banking and finance, purchasing and procurement, Microsoft Excel and Office, communication, problem solving and customer service, plus front-end development, graphic design, video editing and motion design.
